explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows two manufacturers discontinuing doxycycline hyclate products; our current label names a plant with VAI inspections but no OAI record

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list records Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. discontinuing doxycycline hyclate tablets with an initial posting date of 2026-01-12.
FDA's shortage list also records Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. discontinuing doxycycline hyclate delayed-release tablets with an initial posting date of 2026-07-30.
Our product label names Zydus Lifesciences Limited as the manufacturing plant (FEI 3007938603) with operations including manufacture.
FDA inspection records for this plant show multiple VAI classifications, most recently an inspection ending 2023-03-24 classified VAI.
No FDA inspection record for this plant shows an OAI classification in the provided evidence.
Corvale Lakeside holds 19 days on hand, while Corvale East and Corvale General each hold 30 days on hand.
Check whether the Zydus plant has any recent inspection actions not captured here and confirm A-S Medication Solutions can supply the needed NDC.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-707133.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%doxycycline%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%doxycycline%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-7628d2.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('51d245a3-ef51-474a-bc91-377d5f42dde3') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-f865a1.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%doxycycline%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-2d95f0.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%doxycycline%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-9dc2b1.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%doxycycline%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-87e7ca.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3007938603') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-30871b.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3007938603') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-01e61e.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3007938603') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('zydus lifesciences')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-1054b4.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('zydus lifesciences', 'viona') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%doxycycline%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-389c04.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('72578005501')

Q-d3a0f1.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%doxycycline%'
